title: RAMA vs Mean Aggregation on rel-amazon/item-ltv (Large-Scale Regression)
summary: Demo notebook for RAMA (Rank-Aware Moment Aggregation) vs standard Mean Aggregation on rel-amazon/item-ltv. Implements standalone RAMA module in PyTorch with unit tests verifying zero-init correctness and gradient flow. Loads pre-computed results from 5-seed, 10-epoch HeteroSAGE GNN experiment (506K products, 20.8M reviews). Runs statistical analysis (paired t-test p=8.9e-5, Cohen's d=10.83, 7.76% MAE improvement) and produces 4-panel visualization of MAE comparison, training curves, gate analysis, and epoch times.
